_note: Registry of texts built by scripts/build_texts.py and checked by scripts/validate.py. The Bhagavad Gita (data/gita.json) has its own builder and schema.

isha_upanishad.title: Isha Upanishad
isha_upanishad.count_basis: Kāṇva recension, 18 mantras; source markers and Śaṅkara's bhāṣya page agree

kena_upanishad.title: Kena Upanishad
kena_upanishad.count_basis: Source numbering (35 mantras: 9, 5, 12, 9). Śaṅkara's bhāṣya page counts 8 in khaṇḍa 1, joining our 1.3 and 1.4

katha_upanishad.title: Katha Upanishad
katha_upanishad.count_basis: 119 mantras (29, 25, 17, 15, 15, 18) plus the closing peace chant, which both the source and Śaṅkara's bhāṣya number as 2.3.19 (Śaṅkara comments on it)

nitishataka.title: Nitishataka of Bhartrihari
nitishataka.count_basis: Source numbering 1-110; the source has no verse 7. Two unnumbered opening verses (an invocation and 'yāṃ cintayāmi') are not units.

vidura_niti.title: Vidura Niti
vidura_niti.count_basis: Verses numbered in order within each chapter (Mahabharata Udyoga Parva 33-40 in this source). The source's own markers repeat or are missing in places; each record keeps it in source.marker.

VN.1.8.speaker: Vidura
VN.1.8.evidence: VN.1.7 says Vidura, entering, spoke with folded hands; 1.8 is his words ('I am Vidura...'), but the page has no 'विदुर उवाच' line, so the narrator Vaishampayana would carry over.

VN.3.10.speaker: Sudhanva
VN.3.10.evidence: Snapshot rev 37534 heads this verse 'विदुर उवाच', but the verse addresses Virochana as 'प्राह्रादे' (son of Prahlada) and refuses to share his seat; Virochana's reply (VN.3.11) addresses 'सुधन्वन्'. The speaker is Sudhanva.

chanakya_niti.title: Chanakya Niti
chanakya_niti.count_basis: Verses numbered in order within each of 17 chapters (Cāṇakyanītidarpaṇa, 343 verses). The source's own markers are irregular in places ('१.१०', '१७.२०'); each record keeps it in source.marker. The appendix 'प्रकीर्णश्लोकाः' (unnumbered or doubtful verses) is excluded.
